title: Can we trust AI to detect healthy multilingual English speakers among the cognitively impaired cohort in the UK? An investigation using real-world conversational speech

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing Word Error Rates (WER) of ASR systems, cognitive impairment classification accuracy and misclassification rates (using SVMs and LLMs), and Mini-Mental State Examination (MMSE) score regression errors between monolingual native English speakers and multilingual speakers from ethnic minority backgrounds with distinct accents.
